newsitem.title: USA: Leggoons to license Home Point assets.
newsitem.headline: Leggoons to license Home Point assets.

text.p: Leggoons Inc on Tuesday said it entered an agreement to license technology from Home Point of Sales Inc.

The company also said Thomas Hughes, chairman of Home Point, would become chairman and president of Leggoons on March 1. He will focus on developing various types of wagering based on ATM card and SMART card technology.
Hughes is currently searching for a chief executive officer.

Under the licensing agreement, signed February 18, Leggoons will issue 2.9 million share of restricted common stock to Home Point in exchange for licensing home ATM and SMART card wagering technology developed by the company.

Of these shares, 2.755 million will be placed in escrow and will not be released unless the company's common stock price meets certain conditions. The agreement also provides for additional shares of the restricted stock to be issued to Home Point upon the achievement of certain goals.

"Management believes the proprietary technology and the large demand for wagering opportunities in today's marketplace will combine to generate substantial sales for the company over the medium term," Leggoons said in a statement.
The company said it intended to seek shareholder approval to change its name to Betting Inc.
